question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank with the synonym of the underlined word.

The designer came up with a __fascinating__ idea. Even the professionals found it _________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**captivating**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence suggests that the idea was so interesting that even the professionals found it interesting.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Fascinating" means something extremely interesting or charming.**(आकर्षक)
 
 
• Example: It was a fascinating story.
 
 
 
• **Captivating means attractive or interesting.**(मनोरम)
 
 
• Example: The story was so captivating that I did not even realize the time.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "captivating" is a synonym of "fascinating."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, irritating, means causing annoyance or frustration.(चिड़चिड़ा)
 
• Option 2, annoying, means causing irritation or displeasure.(कष्टप्रद)
 
• Option 3, crafty, means clever or sly.(चालाक)
